comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 is 1 if any comment explicitly engages (addresses, questions, rebuts, accepts or builds on) a specific example or premise the OP cited, and engagement need not be critical. Item 1 is 1 only if a comment first explicitly acknowledges a valid point in the OP's view and then, later in the same comment, disagrees. Item 1 requires an acknowledge-then-disagree structure, and item 0 requires tying the comment to a specific OP example or premise. A comment can satisfy one and not the other. The source sets and null rules also differ.
